scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && (npm run dev -w @gitarena/api & npm run dev -w @gitarena/web)
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run dev -w @gitarena/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run dev -w @gitarena/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run build -w @gitarena/api && npm run build -w @gitarena/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gitarena/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gitarena/api && npm run typecheck -w @gitarena/web
